sources.title: Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Standard Bangla Grammar, Vols. 1-3)
sources.citation: Bangla Academy. (2012). Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Vols. 1-3, Ed. Rafiqul Islam & Pabitra Sarkar). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Authoritative standard for Bangladesh grammar, orthography, and morphology. Used strictly for rule extraction and morphological paradigms; no bulk text copying.

sources.title: Bangla Academy Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom (Standard Bangla Spelling Rules)
sources.citation: Bangla Academy. (2016). Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom. Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Authoritative baseline for orthographic normalization, consonant doubling rules, and vowel harmony orthography.

sources.title: Bangladesher Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan (Regional Dialect Dictionary of Bangladesh)
sources.citation: Shahidullah, M. (Ed.). (1965). Bangladesher Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan (Vols. 1-3). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Exhaustive institutional catalog of regional Bangladesh vocabulary across Sylhet, Chittagong, Noakhali, Barishal, Rangpur, Rajshahi, and Dhaka.

sources.title: Bangla Academy Bengali-English Dictionary (3rd Edition)
sources.author_or_org: Mohammad Ali et al. / Bangla Academy
sources.citation: Ali, M., Ahmad, K., et al. (Eds.). (2019). Bangla Academy Bengali-English Dictionary (3rd ed.). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Standard institutional reference for bilingual translation equivalence, POS tagging, and idiomatic phrases.

sources.title: The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language (ODBL)
sources.citation: Chatterji, S. K. (1926). The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language (Vols. 1-2). Calcutta: Calcutta University Press.
sources.notes: Foundational historical and comparative phonology, morphology, and dialectal evolution treatise.

sources.title: Bakkototto (Bangla Syntax)
sources.citation: Azad, H. (1984). Bakkototto. Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Pioneering transformational-generative analysis of Bangla constituent order, topicalization, passivization, and complex predicates.

sources.title: Bengali: A Comprehensive Grammar
sources.citation: Thompson, H.-R. (2012). Bengali: A Comprehensive Grammar. London & New York: Routledge.
sources.notes: Extensive empirical documentation of modern colloquial spoken Bangla, compound verbs, clitics, and echo words.

sources.title: Universal Dependencies Bengali Treebank (bn_bengal)
sources.citation: Universal Dependencies Consortium. (2023). Universal Dependencies Treebank for Bengali (Release 2.12).
sources.notes: Reference for cross-linguistic dependency relations, UPOS tagging, and morphological feature mapping.

sources.title: IndicCorp v2 (Bengali Monolingual Web Corpus)
sources.citation: Kakwani, D., et al. (2020). IndicNLPSuite: Monolingual Corpora, Evaluation Benchmarks and Pre-trained Multilingual Language Models for Indian Languages. Findings of EMNLP 2020.
sources.notes: Massive web-scale crawl corpus useful for statistical token distributions, character n-gram coverage, and pretraining baselines.

sources.name: Bengali.AI Multiregional Speech Corpus & Common Voice Bangla
sources.title: Bengali.AI Multiregional Speech Corpus & Common Voice Bangla
sources.citation: Al Muntashir, T., et al. (2022). Bengali.AI Speech: A Crowdsourced Multiregional Speech Corpus for Bengali. Proceedings of LREC 2022.
sources.notes: Authoritative open crowdsourced speech corpus covering multiregional Bangladesh accents and phonetic distributions.

sources.title: Banglish-to-Bengali Transliteration & Normalization Dataset
sources.citation: Alam, F., Chowdhury, S. A., et al. (2021). Banglish to Bengali Transliteration with Character-Level Sequence-to-Sequence Models. Proceedings of WNUT 2021, 126-135.
sources.notes: 125,000 parallel sentence pairs mapping informal Romanized Banglish to canonical Bengali script.

sources.title: SentiraBangla: Multi-Domain Sentiment & Code-Mixed Dataset
sources.author_or_org: Md. Arid Hasan et al. (IUB / SUST)
sources.citation: Hasan, M. A., et al. (2022). SentiraBangla: A Multi-Domain Sentiment and Code-Mixed Corpus for Bengali. Findings of EMNLP 2022.
sources.notes: Empirical dataset of 21,000 sentences capturing Bangladesh commercial and social media code-mixing.

sources.title: IndicTrans / Bharat Parallel Corpus (Bangla-English Bitext)
sources.citation: Ramesh, G., et al. (2022). IndicTrans2: Towards High-Quality and Accessible Machine Translation for Indian Languages. Findings of EMNLP 2022.
sources.notes: 8.5M parallel sentence pairs for Bangla-English translation evaluation and bitext alignment.

sources.title: Sylheti Language Corpus & Nagri Script Archive
sources.citation: Lloyd-Williams, J., et al. (2020). Sylheti Language Documentation and Nagri Archival Collection. London: SOAS ELAR Archive.
sources.notes: Academic audio and transcribed recordings of authentic Sylheti dialect morphosyntax, verbal clitics, and traditional Nagri texts.

sources.title: A Linguistic Analysis of Chittagonian (Chatgaya) Phonology & Morphology
sources.author_or_org: Muhammad Abdul Hai et al. / Chittagong University
sources.citation: Hai, M. A., & Hossain, K. A. (Eds.). (2018). Studies in Chittagonian Dialectology and Phonology. Chittagong: University of Chittagong Press.
sources.notes: Monograph analyzing Chatgaya pitch-accent distinctions, post-verbal negation (*-no*), and nominal case allomorphy.
